methods.description: Evaluate each power before addition or subtraction.
Evaluate powers before multiplication or division.
Apply the same order within brackets before the outside operation.
Evaluate a bracket before its power; distinguish an outside multiplier.
After powers, perform multiplication and division from left to right; diagnose a reversal.
Evaluate the full numerator and denominator before division.
Compare grouping effects and insert brackets for a requested value.
Combine the taught order across a complete multi-stage expression.
